title: Acceptance harness for quantized model profiles with adversarial and drift checks
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an automated acceptance harness that validates FP8/INT8 quantization profiles and calibration outputs against an anchored prompt corpus and a set of adversarial/synthetic perturbations. The harness will compute fine-grained accuracy deltas (per-token logit delta, token-level accuracy, and n-gram BLEU/ROUGE-style metrics), generate pass/fail decisions at the batch level, integrate with CI (GitHub Actions) and nightly regression runs, and produce artifacts (failing examples, diffs, and summary dashboards) for SRE/Model-ops review. This ticket focuses on the harness control plane, metric definitions, gating logic, and integration with the calibration pipeline so that any calibration or profile change automatically triggers deterministic validation runs and a gated rollout if thresholds are met.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs deterministically for a given model+profile+seed and outputs a reproducible report (summary + top 100 failing prompts)
Define and implement at least three metrics: per-token average logit delta, token-level pass rate under tolerant decoding, and n-gram similarity (BLEU) with configurable thresholds
Support anchor corpus (golden prompts) + 3 adversarial perturbation strategies (synonym swap, truncation/noise, prefix-split) and include automated generation of perturbations
Batch-level pass/fail gating implemented: runs mark profile as PASS only if all batch gates and aggregate metrics pass configured thresholds
CI integration: PRs that modify calibration/quantization code trigger the harness and block merge on failing gates
Dashboard artifact uploaded to our observability bucket with links in PR and a short triage playbook
Canary rollout integration: passing profiles can be promoted to canary targets via the existing rollout orchestration API (with manual approval step)
tasks: Design metric set and threshold defaults (Maya)
Implement harness core runner (Diego) - CLI + python lib to run model/profile combos
Add perturbation generator module (unit tests + sampling controls)
Integrate with calibration pipeline so a new calibration commit triggers the harness
Wire GitHub Actions job and PR status checks
Build artifact uploader and small dashboard template (S3 -> Console link)
Create triage/playbook document and runbook for failures

test_plan: Unit tests for runner and perturbation generator; integration test that runs a small anchor subset in CI (fast job) and nightly full-run with larger corpus; regression test asserts that known-good profile remains within configured tolerances; fuzz test that ensures harness handles non-deterministic seeds and returns consistent pass/fail across repeated runs with same seed.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge harness to main behind feature flag. 2) Enable CI checks for calibration/quant PRs (fast subset). 3) Nightly full-run and dashboard updates. 4) Allow promotion of passing profiles to canary via manual approval. 5) Monitor canary for 72 hours, then full rollout if no regressions.
notes: We intentionally use both similarity (BLEU-style) and deltas on model logits to capture semantic and distributional shifts. Future work: add learned regressors that predict end-user metric impact and surface prioritized failing prompts. Keep log retention low to comply with privacy guidance. Consider adding a privacy-preserving hashed prompt id to share with external partners for triage.
